title: Sandpiper Point Rising Revisited
author: Ada Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Quintana, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
